name: culture-safe-report
title: Grade report that survives French Windows
prompt:
`report.ps1 -Path <file.csv>` must print the average grade per group from an Excel-exported CSV:
- file: UTF-8 with BOM, delimiter `;`, header `name;group;grade`, grades with a decimal comma
  (`12,5`) or a dot, blank lines ignored
- one line per group, groups sorted by name: `G1: 12.75 (2 students)` — average with exactly two
  decimals and a DOT, whatever the Windows regional settings (it must give the same output on a
  French `fr-FR` system and an English `en-US` system); always the word `students`
It must run on Windows PowerShell 5.1.
